DVR Guide
fields.options:
Document Visibility Rule (DVR) - Configuration Guide

Document Visibility Rules control who can see which documents without modifying Role Permission Manager (RPM) or Workflow permissions. They operate as an additional visibility filter layered on top of standard Frappe permissions.

How DVR Works

  • DVR controls READ visibility only
  • Users must already have READ permission via Role Permission Manager
  • DVR can only take visibility away -- it never grants access RPM has not already given
  • Visibility rules are evaluated for:
    • List Views
    • Reports
    • Link fields
    • Direct document access

Visibility Logic

Each rule is evaluated in two layers:

  1. Base Visibility (OR)
    • Creator-based visibility
    • Assignment-based visibility
    • Team-expanded visibility
    • Custom visibility expression
  2. Restriction (AND)
    • Custom restriction expression

A document is visible when some rule that applies to the user grants base visibility and that same rule's restriction passes. A restriction never leaks across into another role's rule.

Multiple Roles

If a user holds several roles, each role's rule is evaluated independently and the results are combined with OR.

If:

  • Role A allows visibility only where doc.status == "Open"
  • Role B allows visibility only where doc.status == "Closed"

Result:
The user can see documents that are Open or Closed.

Team Visibility

When Visible to Team is enabled, visibility is expanded to include users belonging to the same User Groups.

Expression Rules

Expressions use a restricted Python syntax and are safely compiled to SQL.

Allowed
  • doc.fieldname
  • ==, !=, >, <, >=, <=
  • in, not in
  • is None, is not None
  • and, or
Not Allowed
  • Function calls
  • Method access
  • Dynamic code
  • Anything other than doc.<fieldname> and literals
